dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you played it for Mamere?

dialogues.speaker: Topyas
dialogues.text: N—Not yet, I'm afraid. I mean, she's often out of the village, and no one can find her when that happens.

dialogues.speaker: Topyas
dialogues.text: But when she's around, I also feel kinda... embarrassed... This song's supposed to be a gift, after all. I have to practice a few more times...

dialogues.speaker: Topyas
dialogues.text: But I'll find a chance to play for her. I'm sure of it!
